proofs.text: Call `runners_for(["windows", "linux"])`; verify `["ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest"]` in that fixed order. Call it with `["windows"]`; verify `["ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest"]`, so the Linux job survives a tag that never names it. Call it with `["linux"]`; verify `["ubuntu-latest"]` once, not twice. Call it with an empty list and with `["plan9"]`; verify `["ubuntu-latest"]` both times, so an unknown name is ignored rather than guessed at. Call `render_workflow("github", ["windows"], "v<VERSION>")`; verify it holds `os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]`. Read the fixture's workflow; verify it holds `os: [ubuntu-latest]` and no `windows-latest`, and that `env_tags_in_specs()` over the fixture returns `["linux"]`

rule_text: The matrix always covers Linux first, then one job per other operating system the project's `@env` tags name, so a project that tags nothing and a project that tags only Windows both keep a Linux job

tests.body:
def test_the_matrix_always_carries_linux_first():
    """Every untagged proof is proved somewhere, so the Linux job always runs."""
    assert workflow_module.runners_for(['windows']) == [
        'ubuntu-latest', 'windows-latest']
    assert workflow_module.runners_for(['linux']) == ['ubuntu-latest']
    assert workflow_module.runners_for(['macos', 'windows']) == [
        'ubuntu-latest', 'macos-latest', 'windows-latest']
    rendered = workflow_module.render_workflow('github', ['windows'], PURLIN_REF)
    assert 'os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]' in rendered
tests.name: test_the_matrix_always_carries_linux_first

def test_the_matrix_is_one_job_per_named_operating_system():
    """Linux always leads, the order is fixed, and an unknown name is ignored."""
    assert workflow_module.runners_for(['windows', 'linux']) == [
        'ubuntu-latest', 'windows-latest']
    assert workflow_module.runners_for([]) == ['ubuntu-latest']
    assert workflow_module.runners_for(['plan9']) == ['ubuntu-latest']
tests.name: test_the_matrix_is_one_job_per_named_operating_system

def test_the_matrix_is_the_one_operating_system_the_spec_names():
    jobs = '\n'.join(parse_blocks(read(WORKFLOW_REL))['jobs'])
    assert 'os: [ubuntu-latest]' in jobs
    assert 'windows-latest' not in jobs
    assert workflow_module.env_tags_in_specs(FIXTURE) == ['linux']
tests.name: test_the_matrix_is_the_one_operating_system_the_spec_names
